name: Luma Health
short_description: Luma Health is a patient engagement platform focused on scheduling optimization, appointment reminders, and reducing no-shows.
long_description: Luma Health is a patient success platform that focuses on scheduling optimization, patient communication, and reducing no-show rates. The platform uses AI-powered automation to handle appointment reminders, waitlist management, and patient outreach. Luma Health integrates with major EHR systems and serves large healthcare organizations seeking to improve patient access and operational efficiency. The company is backed by major healthcare investors and serves health systems across the United States.
one_liner: Patient engagement platform for scheduling optimization and reducing no-shows.
best_for: Large healthcare organizations needing scheduling optimization
Multi-location practices requiring EHR-integrated patient engagement
Organizations focused on reducing no-show rates
Health systems seeking AI-powered communication automation
not_for: Can be expensive for smaller practices
Some difficulty tailoring features to specific needs
